This is my main maize plot, so I must look after it well — maize is what feeds my family. I was lucky to receive a FISP coupon this season, so I will use the subsidised NPK and urea on this plot. I will plant a hybrid seed I bought with the coupon, and I will add some manure from the goats my wife keeps near the house, since the soil here is getting tired. Pesticide is too costly for me, and I do not have any way to irrigate — I will rely on the rains as always. My sons are grown and away, so I will do most of the work myself with my wife, and call on a few young men for ganyu when it is time to ridge and weed.
